name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST, then Draft POST for Same Learner at a Different Provider
description: SLD POSTs a draft apprenticeship for a learner at Provider A (10005077), then SLD POSTs again for the same learner (same ULN) but a different course and a different Provider B (10005078). Both remain unapproved drafts. Exploratory — looking at how the draft-POST path handles the same learner arriving at a second provider before any approval, distinct from the same-provider Progression scenarios. No assertions yet.
